Test Scenario: Delete a single email from the Inbox
Pre-conditions:
1. User is logged in to Gmail
2. Inbox contains at least one email
Test Steps:
1. Open Gmail and navigate to Inbox
2. Hover over any email row
3. Click the checkbox that appears to select the email
4. Click the Trash icon in the toolbar
Test Data: Any existing email in the Inbox
Expected Result:
1. The selected email disappears from Inbox immediately
2. Snackbar appears: '1 conversation moved to Trash'
3. Email is visible in Trash folder
4. Inbox unread count decreases by 1
Notes/Defect Link: Verify Trash is accessible via left sidebar

Test Scenario: Log the title of the last unread email after Gmail login
Pre-conditions:
1. Dedicated Google test account exists
2. Test account Inbox contains at least five unread emails
3. Credentials are supplied through config.properties, Maven system properties, or environment variables
4. If Google asks for OTP/additional verification, current verification code is supplied for the run
Test Steps:
1. Open Google Chrome in a new window
2. Navigate to https://mail.google.com/mail/
3. Enter login email and click Next
4. Enter password and click Next
5. If additional verification appears, enter configured verification code and continue
6. Wait until Inbox is loaded
7. Count unread emails
8. Read the title/subject of the last unread email shown in the mailbox
9. Write the title to gmail-automation/logs/gmail-automation.log
Test Data:
test.email / TEST_EMAIL
test.password / TEST_PASSWORD
test.verification.code / TEST_VERIFICATION_CODE when required
Mailbox with 5+ unread emails
Expected Result:
1. Chrome starts a fresh browser session
2. Gmail login completes successfully
3. Inbox loads and at least five unread emails are detected
4. Last unread email title is captured without opening or modifying the email
5. Log contains entry in the format 'GM-001 LAST_UNREAD_EMAIL_TITLE=<subject>'
